frames.text: Why did China block that deal?
The listener is asking about China blocking a deal, and their position is on the Anthropic model story.
The deal they mean is SoftBank's acquisition of ABB Robotics, which is story 6, so I'll answer from that story.
China's Office of the Working Mechanism for Foreign Investment Security Review prohibited the acquisition.
Regulators were concerned that robotics data could be transferred overseas and used to train AI models.
Chinese regulators were concerned that data for training AI models could be transferred overseas.
